headline: Newcastle Surgeon's 30-Year Mission: 4,000 Children's Hearts Saved
meta_description: Asif Hasan, a Newcastle surgeon, performed over 4,000 open heart operations on children for more than 30 years, taking on cases others refused.
summary_short: A Newcastle surgeon tackled the cases no one else would touch, spending three decades saving children's lives through open heart surgery.
body:
Asif Hasan, a surgeon in Newcastle, has spent more than 30 years performing open heart operations on children—over 4,000 procedures in total. What sets his work apart is not just the volume, but the nature of the cases: Hasan consistently took on children whose conditions other hospitals deemed too risky to operate on.

This commitment to the most vulnerable patients earned him recognition at the Pride of Britain Awards, a testament to a career built on refusing to turn away a child in need. For three decades, Hasan has been the surgeon families turned to when doors closed elsewhere, transforming what seemed impossible into life-saving reality.
quick_facts: Newcastle surgeon Asif Hasan performed over 4,000 open heart operations
Career spanning more than 30 years dedicated to pediatric cardiac surgery
Specialized in high-risk cases other hospitals refused to take
Recognized at the Pride of Britain Awards for his work
